target_genes.selection: THE PANEL. Every member shares one 541-feature var list, of which 198 are control features (NegControlCodeword, NegControlProbe, UnassignedCodeword) and are excluded here; the remaining 343 genes are the panel. On Xenium, gene selection is the panel (plan section 3 P6).
